# pve_sdn_ipam (Resource)

SDN IPAM backend configuration (pve, netbox, phpipam).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "pve_sdn_ipam" "example" {
ipam = "CHANGE_ME"
type = "netbox"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `ipam` (String) The SDN ipam object identifier.
- `type` (String) Plugin type. One of: `netbox`, `phpipam`, `pve`.

### Optional

- `delete` (String) A list of settings you want to delete.
- `fingerprint` (String) Certificate SHA 256 fingerprint.
- `lock_token` (String) the token for unlocking the global SDN configuration
- `section` (Number) <integer>
- `token` (String, Sensitive) <string>
- `url` (String) <string>

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Opaque identifier: ipam (also the `terraform import` format).
